snapshot_description: Metadados do projeto CRL no Supabase. Sem dados pessoais nem linhas reais. Somente para auditoria, nao substitui migracoes completas. Projeto compartilhado com DDS Avaliacoes.

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((report_status = 'draft'::text) AND (approved_at IS NULL) AND (approved_by IS NULL) AND (approved_text IS NULL)) OR ((report_status = 'approved'::text) AND (approved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_by IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_text IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((monitor_vinculo IS NULL) OR ((role = 'monitor'::text) AND (monitor_vinculo = ANY (ARRAY['aluno'::text, 'voluntario'::text, 'contratado'::text])))))

CHECK (((monitor_vinculo IS NULL) OR (role <> 'monitor'::text) OR (((monitor_vinculo = 'aluno'::text) AND (resident_id IS NOT NULL) AND (salary_monthly IS NULL)) OR ((monitor_vinculo = 'voluntario'::text) AND (resident_id IS NULL) AND (salary_monthly IS NULL)) OR ((monitor_vinculo = 'contratado'::text) AND (resident_id IS NULL) AND ((salary_monthly IS NULL) OR (salary_monthly > (0)::numeric))))))
CHECK (((char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM justification)) >= 3) AND (char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM justification)) <= 2000)))
CHECK (((char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM purpose)) >= 3) AND (char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM purpose)) <= 500)))
